functions.purpose: Lazily resolves and caches the interned id for the game mode string "WildHunt". Returns cached value at this+0x20 if non-zero; otherwise walks camera/level manager (DAT_1202e818+0xd0 -> +0x90 -> vfunc 0xb4) and, only if that object's flag at +0x260fc != 0, interns "WildHunt" via FUN_1122b8f0 and caches it at this+0x20.
formulas: cache slot: this+0x20 (returns early if != 0)
id = FUN_1122b8f0("WildHunt") (string intern/hash)
functions.notes: WildHunt is an MHO PvE/hunt mode. This is a mode-id memoizer; not authoritative logic. DAT_1202e818 is the global engine/context singleton used throughout this chunk (managers at +0x30 particle, +0x50 entity, +0xd0 level/camera, +0x4 world, +0x16 record, +0xa0 char).

functions.purpose: Builds the level-loading UI/screen dataset: picks a weighted-random loading tip, evaluates operation-activity data, selects loading-animation elements, and for specific map ids (0x2bf85 / 0x2bfe9) chooses a WildHunt/xHunter background. Pure UI/data assembly written into the passed struct (param_4).
formulas: hunt rank: iStack_15c = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount() (only if a valid actor found)

tip group filter per entry: entry+0x18 <= huntRank <= entry+0x1c AND (entry+0x14 == 0 || entry+0x14 == uStack_16c[some category from record+0x20]); weight range accumulator ppuVar16 = prev + entry+0x20 (weight at +0x10)
tip roll: r = rand() % totalWeight; select bucket where bucket[1] <= r < bucket[2]

data-info index math (repeated pattern): idx = key - mgr+0x30; row = *(mgr+0x20 + (idx / mgr+0x28)*4); elem = *(row + (idx % mgr+0x28)*4); count = (elem+0x18 - elem+0x14)>>3 (or /0x1c, or >>2 depending on stride); pick = rand()%count
background pick (map 0x2bf85 or 0x2bfe9): rand()&0x80000001 parity chooses "wildhunt"/"xHunter"; when both flags set: rand()%3==0 -> "xHunter", %3==1/2 -> parity of that toward wildhunt
aeroboat gating: only if local_150[8]>0 && ppuStack_174>0 && they differ && cVar17 (screen type (local_154 & 0x8f)==10)
functions.notes: Emits keys: tipsString, loadingOperationPath, loadingNewMapPath, gameLoadingElementPic/Title/Desc, specialText, loadingAnimStyle, loadingCharImgPath, levelMainBGPath, loadingTutorialShow, flyingTime, canMoveAeroBoat, sourcePosX/Y, destPosX/Y, mapName, hasLoadingNewMapData. Map ids 0x2bf85=179589, 0x2bfe9=179689. Not monster AI; it is the loading UI that happens to reference WildHunt.

functions.purpose: Behavior-tree actor init from an entity's script 'Properties' table. If bHaveBehaviorTree is true, marks this+0xc4=1, reads bLevelActor, obtains the AI/level-actor manager (DAT_1202e818+0xd0), pulls the actor's group/context (manager+0x1d) and registers a CBTActor via FUN_10a685d0/FUN_10a68570. Branches on entity state this+0x155c (1 vs 8) to pick a spawn context; state 8 uses "CatInCity" when the level manager reports in-city (vfuncs 0x16c/0x164).
formulas: gate: Properties table present AND bHaveBehaviorTree(local_10)!=0
sets this+0xc4 = 1 (has-BT flag); reads bLevelActor -> local_5
context id local_10 = *(levelMgr + 0x1d*4 = +0x74)
state switch: this+0x155c == 1 -> FUN_10a60b80 path; == 8 -> in-city test; else default
if levelMgr in-city (vfunc 0x16c || 0x164) -> FUN_100e0410("CatInCity") else FUN_100e0410(*(levelActor[0x7b4]+0x94))
if DAT_1202e818+0x209 == 0 (non-editor?) and !bLevelActor: FUN_10a685d0(...,1) and if resulting node's +8 child count *( *(ret+8)+0x28) > 0 set this+0x157d = 1
functions.notes: MHO-specific BT actor bootstrap. Server drives monster BT so it must load bHaveBehaviorTree/bLevelActor and register the actor. this+0x155c is an actor-type/state enum (1=?, 8=city-cat variant). refcount++/-- pattern (puVar6[1]) is CryEngine smart-ptr.

functions.purpose: Loads the AI perception/anger + spawn-cap settings from the '/Scripts/AI' config node (via localization/root path FUN_10478770). Iterates config entries reading each entry's name (DAT_11dbac80) and 'value', matching against a fixed set of setting names and writing them into the AI-settings struct (iVar2).
formulas: DefaultAnger        -> *(float*)(settings+0x40) = atof(value)  [FUN_10a933f0 = parse float]
AngerPeak           -> *(float*)(settings+0x44)
BaseDecayFactor     -> *(float*)(settings+0x54)
MaxDecayOffset      -> *(float*)(settings+0xa4)
MaxAgentsIntensitySpawned -> *(float*)(settings+0xac)
MaxEnemiesSpawned   -> *(int*)(settings+0xb0)   [FUN_10a93410 = parse int]
name key attribute read via DAT_11dbac80 ('name'); value key literal 'value'
costs: MaxAgentsIntensitySpawned = cap on concurrently spawned high-intensity agents
MaxEnemiesSpawned = hard cap on concurrently spawned enemies
functions.notes: HIGH interest: this is the global aggro/anger tuning (anger baseline, peak, exponential-style decay factor + max decay offset) plus AI spawn caps. Server must load identical values to reproduce threat/anger decay and spawn limits. DefaultAnger/AngerPeak/BaseDecayFactor/MaxDecayOffset are the anger-model constants; MaxEnemiesSpawned/MaxAgentsIntensitySpawned are spawn-manager caps. Complements the per-monster anger fields in combat.md (EmotionAngryTime@+0xa50, AngryDamagePeakValue@+0xa54).

functions.purpose: Instantiates the behavior tree (or BT control object) for an entity. Looks up an existing BT record by the entity's BT name (vfunc 0x50); if none, resolves the entity class's script and checks whether it derives from 'BehaviorTreeBase' or 'BTCtrlObject', then creates the appropriate BT instance (FUN_11317f30 -> vfunc 0xc0, or FUN_10b24e30). If a record exists, bumps instance counter (this+0x1c) and starts/attaches the tree via FUN_10db7340 keyed by (this+0x1b + this+0x1c).
formulas: early-out: FUN_11318380() true -> return 1
class-kind branch: script class 'BehaviorTreeBase' -> tree; 'BTCtrlObject' -> control object
instance id = this+0x1b (base) + ++this+0x1c (per-instance counter); this+0x1a low byte = flags; this+0x18 = BT context
return 2 on successful (re)instantiate, 1 otherwise
functions.notes: Core MHO monster BT instantiation. Server-authoritative: the BT that drives monster behavior is built here. 'BehaviorTreeBase' vs 'BTCtrlObject' distinguishes a full behavior tree from a lightweight controller. m_pThis_exref = entity-system singleton.

functions.purpose: GM/debug command handler that serializes monster AI info (GmMonsterAiInfo.xml) and streams it back to the requester as protocol message id 0x71, chunked into <=0x7ff-byte packets (multi-part with a part-flag field). If access level (vfunc 4) < 2 it instead just references the xml filename.
formulas: packet id = 0x71 at *local_18
chunk size = 0x7ff bytes; nChunks = (size + 0x7fe)/0x7ff
part flag at local_18+10: 0=single, 1=first, 2=middle, 3=last; result code at local_18+8
privilege gate: (*param_1 vfunc4) >= 2 required to dump
copy loop uses 0x1ff dwords (=0x7fc) + 2-byte + 1-byte tail = 0x7ff per chunk (strncpy/memcpy limit 0x7ff)
functions.notes: Server-side GM tooling that emits monster AI state; privilege-checked (level>=2). Not gameplay math. Confirms server owns monster AI info and can dump it.

functions.purpose: Given an entity class/archetype, walks its script definition for 'AISetting' nodes and preloads the referenced behavior-tree assets: sBTFolder (base path, prefixed '/Scripts/AI/BehaviorTree/'), sBlackBoardFile, sEventBT, and per-child 'BehaviorTree'/'ClientBehaviorTree' collections' sFilename entries. Loads via the BT loader at param_2+8.
formulas: node name selector: param_3 low byte -> 'ClientBehaviorTree' if !=0 else 'BehaviorTree'
base folder literal '/Scripts/AI/BehaviorTree/' set on loader (vfunc 0x1c)
keys: sBTFolder, sBlackBoardFile (vfunc 0x18 load), sEventBT (AISystem::LoadEntityBehaviorTree_Recursive), sFilename (vfunc 4, flag 1)
functions.notes: MHO BT asset preloader. Distinguishes server 'BehaviorTree' from 'ClientBehaviorTree' collections (param_3 flag) — server should load the server-side tree set. AISystem::LoadEntityBehaviorTree_Recursive is a named import.

functions.purpose: Scans /Libs/EntityArchetypes/*.xml (findfirst/next), parses each EntityPrototypeLibrary/EntityPrototype/Properties, and for prototypes declaring a BTFolder preloads their behavior-tree files: file_BlackBoardFile, file_BTEventFileName, file_BTFileName1..3, resolving them under 'Scripts/AI/BehaviorTree/<BTFolder>'.
formulas: glob: <gameRoot>/Libs/EntityArchetypes/*.xml
BT path = 'Scripts/AI/BehaviorTree/' + BTFolder (FUN_104977f0 join)
keys: BTFolder, file_BlackBoardFile (loader vfunc 0x18), file_BTEventFileName (vfunc 4,1), file_BTFileName1/2/3 (vfunc 4,1)
param_2 flag chooses per-archetype id path (DAT_11df7390 auto-increment id) vs caller-provided loader (param_1)
functions.notes: Bulk archetype BT preload. DAT_11df7390 is a monotonically increasing prototype id counter. Server needs these to know each monster archetype's BT/blackboard set.

functions.purpose: Parses an ammo/projectile (spawnable entity) params from its script: a 'flags' sub-node (ClientOnly/ServerOnly/ServerSpawn/PredictSpawn/Reusable) and a 'params' sub-node (lifetime, showtime, bulletType, hitPoints, noBulletHits, quietRemoval, sleepTime, radius, aitype).
formulas: flags bits into *param_1: ClientOnly -> |0x100 ; ServerOnly -> |0x200
ServerSpawn(bool) -> byte at param_1+4; if ServerSpawn set -> PredictSpawn(bool) -> byte param_1+5; else Reusable(bool) -> byte param_1+6

params: lifetime -> param_1+8(float via vfunc0x1c); showtime -> param_1+0xc; bulletType(int) -> param_1+0x14; hitPoints(int) -> param_1+0x18; noBulletHits(bool) -> param_1+0x1c; quietRemoval(bool) -> param_1+0x1d; sleepTime(float) -> param_1+0x20; radius(float) -> param_1+0x30
aitype string: _stricmp 'grenade' -> *(u16*)(param_1+0x10)=0x96 (150); 'rpg' -> 0x97 (151)
functions.notes: Stock CryEngine SAmmoParams parser, but the ServerSpawn/PredictSpawn/Reusable + ClientOnly/ServerOnly flags are directly relevant to spawn authority: ServerSpawn entities must be created server-side, PredictSpawn are client-predicted then reconciled. Server must honor these when deciding what it authoritatively spawns.

3 script args from param_2[0..2] with type-code 4/6/7 refcount handling
functions.notes: Client presentation (particle/audio on boid spawn). Script-function caching pattern.

formulas: float fields into param_2: boid_mass+0x28, boid_size+0xa8, boid_size_random+0xac, min_height+0x38, max_height+0x3c, min_attract_distance+0x44, max_attract_distance+0x40, min_speed+0x50, max_speed+0x4c, factor_align+0x58, factor_cohesion+0x5c, factor_separation+0x60, factor_origin+0x64, factor_keep_height+0x68, factor_avoid_land+0x6c, factor_random_accel+0x78, flight_time+0x48, factor_take_off+0x70, land_deceleration_height+0x54, max_anim_speed+0x90, max_view_distance+0xa0, spawn_radius+0x1c, gravity_at_death+0x2c
min_attract clamp: if attract_min <= DAT_11de98c4 (epsilon) -> 0.05f; if attract_max <= attract_min -> attract_max = attract_min + DAT_11de98c4
max_animation_distance stored squared: (+0xa4) = d*d

bool flags (byte): follow_player+0x94, avoid_obstacles+0x95, no_landing+0x96, start_on_ground+0x97, avoid_water+0x98, spawn_from_point+0x99
ground sub-node: factor_align+0x7c, factor_cohesion+0x80, factor_separation+0x84, factor_origin+0x88, walk_speed+0x8c, offset+0x9c
Sounds[] and Animations[] loops capped at index < 100

If the entity has PoisonEffect/BurnEffect, builds a network packet (id 0x2a7) with the transformed position/orientation and sends it via m_pThis_exref.

network packet id = 0x2a7; bone name default 'Bip01 Spine' (this+0x58 override)
PoisonEffect/BurnEffect gate via FUN_10a675d0 name compare
functions.notes: Client visual + a status-effect network notify (0x2a7). Heavy quaternion/matrix math is presentation. DAT_11de9a28 is a scale constant.

Spawning: bAutoSpawn->this+0x19, bSpawnOnMovement->this+0x1a, fFrequency->this+0x8

functions.purpose: Creates the in-world entity for a GameCollectPoint (gathering node / captured-monster drop / bound monster). Names it 'CGameCollectPoint_%08x' from netid, resolves the 'MHCommonArea' entity class, fills script properties (collect_point_net_id, collect_type, monster_net_id, monster_info_id, bind_entity_class, life_time, trigger_radius, model_filename, particlefile, Scale), computes spawn position/orientation (including a bone-attached offset with rotation for bound monsters), and spawns the entity via the entity system; marks the source object 'Spawned'.
formulas: entity name = snprintf('CGameCollectPoint_%08x', netid @ collectObj+4)
collect_type = vfunc 0x1c8 (this+0x13 gets model/radius depending on type)
type gate for monster fields: (9 < type) && (type < 0xc || type == 0xe)  i.e. types 10,11,14 carry monster_net_id/monster_info_id/bind_entity_class/life_time
trigger_radius read only when type == 0xb (11)
type 0xe (14): this+0x13 = *(collectObj+0x170); else resolve monster info FUN_107d7df0(monster_info_id) -> +0x938

bound-monster offset (type 3 attachment): pos += monsterInfo[0x255/0x256/599] bone offset; heading angle = monsterInfo[600]*DAT_11de98c0(deg->rad)*DAT_11de98e8(0.5) -> fcos/fsin rotation applied to attach transform
default scale/orientation: 1.0 (0x3f800000); model transform from source object vfunc 0x1c
costs: life_time = collect point despawn timer (from collectObj+0x174)
functions.notes: Monster/collect spawning: server authoritatively creates collect points and their bound monsters. collect_type enum: types 10/11/14 are monster-bearing (11 adds trigger_radius, 14 uses fixed radius field). bind_entity_class links a monster/NPC. Uses MHCommonArea shared entity class. Cross-refs flowgraph node monster/collectPoint/combatNPC outcomes in combat.md:846. DAT_11de98c0=deg->rad, DAT_11de98e8=0.5.
